title: Postgres Connection Pooling at the Edge
excerpt: Serverless and edge workers spawn short-lived processes that exhaust Postgres max_connections in minutes. A single global pool cap does not survive distributed cold starts.
description: Staff patterns for Postgres pooling at the edge: per-worker limits, PgBouncer transaction mode validation, cold-start jitter, and saturation metrics correlated with database CPU.
socialThreadTr: Edge'de Postgres pool global max ile çözülmez; worker başına limit şart. 🧵
PgBouncer transaction mode ve cold start jitter. Detay: https://berktugberke.com/tr/blogs/postgres-connection-pooling-at-the-edge

sections.heading: Global max fails at the edge
paragraphs: Thousands of isolates waking together create connection storms. You see queue backlog before hard database rejections if you are lucky.
Design per-worker pool ceilings and a regional PgBouncer tier instead of hoping max_connections magically scales.

sections.heading: Validate transaction mode with ORM
paragraphs: Session mode often breaks serverless lifecycles. Validate transaction mode with your ORM, prepared statements, and advisory locks in staging.
Bind ORM connection lifecycle strictly to the request boundary—leaked handles become everyone else's outage.
points: Cap pools per edge worker, not one global maximum
Validate PgBouncer transaction mode with your ORM and serverless runtime
Add jitter after cold starts to prevent connection storms
Correlate pool saturation metrics with database CPU

sections.heading: Jitter connections after cold start
paragraphs: Replace simultaneous connects on cold start with randomized backoff. Warm pools or minimum instances cost money but earn their keep on revenue paths.
Document which routes require warm capacity so finance understands the line item.

sections.heading: Correlate saturation with DB CPU
paragraphs: Plot pool wait time and active connections beside Postgres CPU and lock waits.
Page on saturation trends before query timeouts flood application logs and hide the root cause.

sections.heading: Size pools for edge concurrency
paragraphs: Serverless isolates multiply faster than Postgres tolerates connections. Cap pools per worker and region; a single global max either starves functions or hits max_connections on the primary. Track the change in your service catalog, review thresholds quarterly, and attach a dated rollback ticket before the next launch window.

PgBouncer transaction mode breaks prepared statements, advisory locks, and listen-notify unless the ORM is configured explicitly. Test those code paths in staging with the same mode you ship. Track the change in your service catalog, review thresholds quarterly, and attach a dated rollback ticket before the next launch window.

Cold starts synchronize connection opens—add jittered backoff on first connect to prevent storms after deploys. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket. Track the change in your service catalog, review thresholds quarterly, and attach a dated rollback ticket before the next launch window.

sections.heading: Validate ORM against transaction mode
paragraphs: Correlate pool wait time, active clients, and database CPU before customer queries time out. Document session versus transaction pooling per route in architecture records. Track the change in your service catalog, review thresholds quarterly, and attach a dated rollback ticket before the next launch window.

Read replicas should not share writer pool names unless drivers target roles explicitly. Failover drills quarterly for Neon, RDS Proxy, or self-hosted bouncer stacks. Track the change in your service catalog, review thresholds quarterly, and attach a dated rollback ticket before the next launch window.

Treat checkout and search pool saturation as product incidents with route-labeled metrics, not only DBA tickets. Revisit this in your next production review, assign an owner, and attach a dated remediation ticket. Track the change in your service catalog, review thresholds quarterly, and attach a dated rollback ticket before the next launch window.

sections.heading: Pool sizing for serverless and edge workers
paragraphs: Edge functions multiply processes faster than Postgres multiplies connections. Cap pools per worker and region instead of one global maximum that either starves lambdas or exhausts max_connections on the primary. Validate PgBouncer transaction mode against your ORM: prepared statements, advisory locks, and listen-notify patterns break silently when session semantics disappear. Publish dashboards beside error budgets, run game days before major releases, and record owner sign-off in the same change ticket the on-call engineer will read first.

Cold starts create connection storms when every isolate opens a fresh pool simultaneously. Add jittered backoff on first connect and reuse warm pools where the runtime allows. Correlate pool wait time, active clients, and database CPU so saturation shows up before customer queries time out. Document which routes require session pooling versus transaction pooling in the architecture decision record. Publish dashboards beside error budgets, run game days before major releases, and record owner sign-off in the same change ticket the on-call engineer will read first.

Neon, RDS Proxy, and self-hosted PgBouncer differ in TLS termination and credential rotation—test failover drills quarterly. Read replicas should not share the same pool name as writers unless your driver explicitly targets roles. Staging must use smaller pools with the same mode as production; testing session mode in staging and shipping transaction mode invites launch-week surprises. Publish dashboards beside error budgets, run game days before major releases, and record owner sign-off in the same change ticket the on-call engineer will read first.

Treat pool misconfiguration as a product incident when checkout or search routes fail. Export metrics with service and route labels, not only database hostnames. On-call runbooks need explicit steps to drain workers, bounce bouncer, and verify ORM pool settings without restarting the entire cluster. Finance should see connection overhead beside query spend when evaluating edge migration proposals. Publish dashboards beside error budgets, run game days before major releases, and record owner sign-off in the same change ticket the on-call engineer will read first.

sections.heading: Serverless ve edge worker için pool boyutlandırma
paragraphs: Edge function'lar Postgres'in connection çoğaltmasından hızlı process çoğaltır. Lambda'ları aç bırakan veya primary max_connections'ı tüketen tek global max yerine worker ve bölge başına pool cap koyun. PgBouncer transaction mode'u ORM'inize karşı doğrulayın: prepared statement, advisory lock ve listen-notify session semantiği kaybolunca sessizce kırılır.

Cold start her isolate aynı anda taze pool açınca connection fırtınası yaratır. İlk connect'te jittered backoff ekleyin; runtime izin veriyorsa warm pool reuse edin. Pool wait, active client ve DB CPU'yu korele edin; müşteri sorguları timeout olmadan saturation görünsün. ADR'de hangi route'un session pooling, hangisinin transaction pooling gerektirdiğini yazın.

Neon, RDS Proxy ve self-hosted PgBouncer TLS termination ve credential rotation'da farklıdır—çeyreklik failover drill test edin. Read replica writer ile aynı pool adını paylaşmasın, driver rol hedeflemiyorsa. Staging prod ile aynı mode'da daha küçük pool kullansın; staging'de session, prod'da transaction ship etmek launch sürprizi demektir.

Checkout veya arama route'ları fail olunca pool misconfig product incident sayılmalı. Metrikleri yalnızca DB hostname değil service ve route label ile export edin. Runbook worker drain, bouncer bounce ve ORM pool ayarını tüm cluster restart etmeden doğrulama adımlarını içersin. Finans edge migration önerilerinde query harcaması yanında connection overhead görsün.

paragraphs: 在客户查询超时前关联 pool 等待、活跃客户端与 CPU。读副本除非驱动按角色路由否则不与 writer 共用 pool 名。 在服务目录中跟踪变更，每季度评审阈值，并在下一发布窗口前关联带日期的回滚工单。
对 Neon、RDS Proxy 或自建 bouncer 每季度 failover 演练。 在服务目录中跟踪变更，每季度评审阈值，并在下一发布窗口前关联带日期的回滚工单。
将 checkout/search pool 饱和视为带路由标签的产品事故。 请在下次生产评审中复核这一点，指定负责人并关联带日期的整改工单。 在服务目录中跟踪变更，每季度评审阈值，并在下一发布窗口前关联带日期的回滚工单。

sections.heading: 面向 serverless 与 edge 的连接池 sizing
paragraphs: Edge 函数增殖进程的速度快于 Postgres 增殖连接。按 worker 与区域设 pool 上限，而非单一全局最大值——要么饿死 lambda，要么耗尽 primary 的 max_connections。针对 ORM 验证 PgBouncer transaction mode：prepared statement、advisory lock 与 listen-notify 在 session 语义消失时会静默失败。
冷启动时若每个 isolate 同时打开新 pool 会引发连接风暴。首次连接加入 jitter 退避，运行时允许则复用 warm pool。关联 pool 等待、活跃客户端与数据库 CPU，在客户查询超时前看到饱和。在 ADR 记录哪些路由需要 session pooling、哪些需要 transaction pooling。
Neon、RDS Proxy 与自建 PgBouncer 在 TLS 终止与凭证轮换上不同——每季度做 failover 演练。读副本不应与 writer 共用 pool 名，除非驱动显式按角色路由。预发应使用与生产相同模式但更小的 pool；预发 session、生产 transaction 的组合会在发布周制造惊喜。
当 checkout 或 search 路由失败时，应将 pool 误配视为产品事故。按 service 与 route 标签导出指标，而非仅数据库主机名。Runbook 需含 drain worker、bounce bouncer、在不重启整集群情况下验证 ORM pool 的步骤。财务评估 edge 迁移时应同时看到连接开销与查询花费。

ja.title: エッジでのPostgresコネクションプーリング
ja.excerpt: サーバーレスとエッジワーカーは短命プロセスを量産しmax_connectionsが満杯に。グローバルmaxは分散エッジでは不足。
ja.description: エッジ/サーバーレス向けPostgresプール：ワーカーごと上限、PgBouncerトランザクションモード、コールドスタートジッター、飽和指標。

sections.heading: エッジではグローバルmax不足
paragraphs: 多数のisolate同時起動で接続ストーム；DB拒否前にキュー滞留。
ワーカーごと固定プール上限とリージョナルPgBouncer層。

sections.heading: ORMでトランザクションモード検証
paragraphs: セッションモードはサーバーレスと相性悪い；ステージングでトランザクションモードとprepared statement検証。
ORMライフサイクルをリクエスト境界に厳密紐付け。
points: グローバルmaxではなくエッジワーカーごとにプール上限
PgBouncerトランザクションモードをサーバーレスで検証
コールドスタート後の接続ストームにジッター
プール飽和をDB CPUと相関監視

sections.heading: コールドスタート後ジッター
paragraphs: コールドスタート後は同時connectではなくランダムbackoff。
クリティカルルートはwarm poolや最小インスタンス。

sections.heading: 飽和をDB CPUと相関
paragraphs: プール待ちとアクティブ接続をPostgres CPUとロック待ちと同ダッシュボード。
飽和アラートはクエリtimeoutより先にページ。

sections.heading: edge 並行向け pool sizing
paragraphs: serverless isolate は Postgres connection tolerance より速く増殖。worker と region ごと pool cap。transaction mode は ORM config なしで prepared statement を break。 サービスカタログで変更を追跡し、四半期ごとに閾値をレビューし、次の launch ウィンドウ前に日付付き rollback チケットを紐付けてください。
staging は ship と同 mode で path test。cold start は first connect jitter backoff。 サービスカタログで変更を追跡し、四半期ごとに閾値をレビューし、次の launch ウィンドウ前に日付付き rollback チケットを紐付けてください。
route ごと session vs transaction pooling を ADR に記載。 サービスカタログで変更を追跡し、四半期ごとに閾値をレビューし、次の launch ウィンドウ前に日付付き rollback チケットを紐付けてください。

sections.heading: transaction mode で ORM 検証
paragraphs: customer timeout 前に pool wait、active client、DB CPU correlate。read replica は driver role target なし writer pool 名共有禁止。 サービスカタログで変更を追跡し、四半期ごとに閾値をレビューし、次の launch ウィンドウ前に日付付き rollback チケットを紐付けてください。
proxy/bouncer で四半期 failover drill。 サービスカタログで変更を追跡し、四半期ごとに閾値をレビューし、次の launch ウィンドウ前に日付付き rollback チケットを紐付けてください。

checkout/search pool saturation を route label 付き product incident 扱い。 次回の production review で再確認し、オーナーを割り当て、日付付き remediation チケットを紐付けてください。 サービスカタログで変更を追跡し、四半期ごとに閾値をレビューし、次の launch ウィンドウ前に日付付き rollback チケットを紐付けてください。

sections.heading: serverless と edge 向け pool sizing
paragraphs: edge function は Postgres の connection 増より process 増が速い。lambda を飢えさせるか max_connections を枯らす global max ではなく worker と region ごとに pool cap。PgBouncer transaction mode を ORM で検証：prepared statement、advisory lock、listen-notify は session 意味論消失で静かに break。

cold start で各 isolate が同時に新 pool を開くと connection storm。first connect に jitter backoff；runtime が許せば warm pool reuse。pool wait、active client、DB CPU を correlate。ADR に route ごとの session vs transaction pooling。
Neon、RDS Proxy、self-hosted PgBouncer は TLS と credential rotation が異なる—四半期 failover drill。read replica は driver が role target しない限り writer と pool 名共有禁止。staging は prod と同 mode で smaller pool。

checkout や search route fail なら pool misconfig を product incident とする。DB hostname だけでなく service と route label で metric export。runbook に worker drain、bouncer bounce、full cluster restart なし ORM pool 検証。finance は edge migration で query spend 横に connection overhead。
